name: Application - TFCR - Applicant Information Step - Test Script

field.label: Are you an existing tree fruit (apple, cherry, pear, and/or other stone fruit) producer in B.C., farming over one acre of tree fruits, whose primary purpose is the production and sale of tree fruit products?

Are you a taxable entity (e.g., individual, corporation or trust), limited partnership, commune, cooperative with a GST and business number, or First Nation Band?
Is your main farmstead in B.C. and do you file farm income tax (form T2042 or T1273) under the Income Tax Act in B.C.? This eligibility requirement may not be applicable to Indigenous applicants.
Do you commit to maintaining the property as a commercial operation for at least four years after completion of the project?
